_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-80b. docs/house-rules.md is oversized on purpose. Asserted against the review-details row the loader itself writes — `Loaded from \u0060docs/house-rules.md\u0060 (truncated)` — which is the cap reporting that it fired. The previous form asserted LATE-RULE's absence from the whole comment, but the fixture adds house-rules.md as part of the PR, so the diagram and cited-code evidence can quote it from the DIFF without the conventions cap having failed at all. Two different paths, one string. `comment: present` carries the other stated outcome — an over-cap file must not fail or stall the review. Labelled `mechanical` (mergewatch.ai#660): any completed review posts the summary comment (postSummaryOnClean defaults to true; `stayingSilent`, review-agent.ts:1051) and renders a score badge (`formatReviewComment`, comment-formatter.ts:760), so a full-range score and a present comment hold for every model output. The Conventions row, including `(truncated)`, is rendered in code from the loaded source (comment-formatter.ts:1035), not written by the model.
